title: The History of Grand Theft Auto | From 1997 to GTA 6 | Every Game Explained
description: The full story of the Grand Theft Auto series: the 1997 original, the 3D revolution of GTA III, Vice City, San Andreas, GTA IV, the record-breaking GTA V and what comes next with GTA VI.

sections.heading: Where it all began
sections.script: Grand Theft Auto is one of the biggest game series ever made, with hundreds of millions of copies sold. In this video we walk through its whole history, from the original top-down game in nineteen ninety seven, to the three-dimensional revolution of GTA three, the neon nostalgia of Vice City, the huge map of San Andreas, the realism of GTA four, the record-breaking GTA five, and finally what is coming next. If you grew up with these games, this one is for you. Let's roll.

sections.heading: Nineteen ninety seven: the original
sections.script: The series began in nineteen ninety seven with the original Grand Theft Auto, made by DMA Design, a studio in Edinburgh that later became Rockstar North. The game was played from a bird's-eye view, looking down on the city. Its map included Liberty City, San Andreas and Vice City, three places that the series would revisit again and again. The name comes from a term for car theft in the United States. Even then, the idea of freely roaming a city and choosing your own missions made it stand out from other games of its time.

sections.heading: Two thousand one: the 3D revolution
sections.script: Then came the revolution. In two thousand one, Grand Theft Auto three turned the series into a fully three-dimensional open world. You could walk and drive through Liberty City, take on missions, or simply cause chaos and try to survive the police. Critics called it a landmark in open-world design, and so many games copied its formula that people started calling them GTA clones. It first came out on the PlayStation two, with Windows and Xbox versions following later. Almost every modern open-world game owes something to this one.

sections.heading: Two thousand two: Vice City
sections.script: In two thousand two, Grand Theft Auto Vice City took players to a neon-soaked city inspired by nineteen eighties Miami. The biggest strength of this game was its style: the fashion, the cars, the pastel colours and the radio stations full of eighties music. Many fans still call it the most atmospheric game in the series. It is also the very city that returns in GTA six, so the story has come full circle.

sections.heading: Two thousand four: San Andreas
sections.script: Two thousand four brought Grand Theft Auto San Andreas, and it went bigger than anything before it. Instead of a single city, the map covered an entire state, with three cities and the countryside between them. The game introduced character customisation, so you could change how your hero looked and how he was built. It is still one of the most loved games ever made, and players keep going back to it for the exploration, the story, and of course, the cheat codes.

sections.heading: Handheld adventures
sections.script: Between the big games, Rockstar also released spin-offs for handheld consoles. Liberty City Stories came to the PlayStation Portable in two thousand five, followed by Vice City Stories in two thousand six. Then, in two thousand nine, Chinatown Wars arrived, first on the Nintendo DS. These games were smaller in scale, but they proved that the open-world formula could work on a portable device, and many fans consider them hidden gems in the series.

sections.heading: Two thousand eight: Grand Theft Auto four
sections.script: Grand Theft Auto four arrived in April two thousand eight with a much more serious and realistic tone. It returned to Liberty City, now rebuilt with huge attention to detail, and followed Niko Bellic, an immigrant trying to escape his past. Take-Two reported that it sold about six million copies in its first week, with a retail value of more than five hundred million dollars, which made it the biggest entertainment launch of its time. Critics praised the story and the detailed city, and many still rank it among the best games of its generation.

sections.heading: Twenty thirteen: Grand Theft Auto five
sections.script: On September seventeenth, twenty thirteen, Grand Theft Auto five launched, and it changed the industry. The game was set in Los Santos and the wider state of San Andreas, and it let you switch between three heroes: Michael, Franklin and Trevor. Guinness World Records confirmed that it earned more than eight hundred million dollars on its first day and reached one billion dollars in just three days, a record for an entertainment product. A few weeks later GTA Online launched, and it has kept the game alive for years.

sections.heading: The next chapter: Grand Theft Auto six
sections.script: And now the next chapter is almost here. Grand Theft Auto six is set to launch on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six, on PlayStation five and Xbox Series X and S. It returns to Vice City and the state of Leonida, with Lucia and Jason as the two lead characters. The trailers have already broken viewing records online. We have a separate video covering everything Rockstar has confirmed so far, so check that out after this one.

sections.heading: Which one is your favourite
sections.script: So that was the history of Grand Theft Auto, from a top-down original to one of the biggest entertainment franchises on the planet. Now we want to hear from you. Which Grand Theft Auto game is your all-time favourite: Vice City, San Andreas, GTA four, or GTA five?
